item.construct_arsenal.quarterstaff.desc: The Quarterstaff is a defensive polearm designed for light but fast blows against far away opponents.
modifier.construct_arsenal.range.descrip: Tool is extra long, allowing attacking far away monsters
item.construct_arsenal.helix_blade.descr: The Helix Blade is a massive sword with a large number of parts, but it lacks modifier slots as a result.
item.construct_arsenal.throwing_card.des: Throwing Cards are light projectiles that can be thrown at a high velocity. They don't deal nearly as much damage as other options due to their size, but they're more accurate and cheaper to make.
modifier.construct_arsenal.card_sleeve.d: Allows the card to move freely in water and grants an accuracy bonus
item.construct_arsenal.buckler.descripti: The Buckler is a light shield that can be thrown.
modifier.construct_arsenal.far_fetched.f: Throwing shields? I find it hard to believe
modifier.construct_arsenal.far_fetched.d: Ineffective dealing damage while held, but still effective when thrown
item.construct_arsenal.scissors.descript: The Scissors are a set of massive shears that can be charged to deal heavy damage to opponents.
modifier.construct_arsenal.guillotine.de: Charge up, aim at a foe, and release for massive damage!
item.construct_arsenal.siphon_fork.descr: The Siphon Fork is an odd sword with the ability to leech the life out of opponents while weakening them in the process.
modifier.construct_arsenal.leeching.desc: Heals 25% of damage dealt from critical hits and weakens opponents
item.construct_arsenal.longsword.descrip: The Longsword is a nostalgic weapon that provides some defensive properties by functioning as an extra piece of armor.
modifier.construct_arsenal.lunge.descrip: Charge up, aim ahead, and dash into battle! Only functions while grounded.
advancements.construct_arsenal.tools.car: Create at least one shiny sleeved card with a 10/10 grading
